change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The operating mode requirement has been removed; any verification of mode selection or torque ramp differences between Comfort and Sport is no longer mandated, so related tests may be retired or repurposed.

assessments.reason: The test validates accelerator torque response time (VCU-DR-01) and does not involve operating mode selection, which is the removed requirement.
evidence: previous_result PASS (94 ms) meets 100 ms limit

assessments.reason: The test checks pedal/brake arbitration against VCU-DR-01 and VCU-BRK-03; it does not depend on the removed mode requirement.
evidence: comment notes timing not reported, but timing is unrelated to mode

assessments.reason: The test measures high‑load torque transient timing without referencing any mode behavior.
evidence: procedure sweeps demand 75–95% and records 92 ms

assessments.reason: It validates emergency‑brake command latency (VCU-BRK-03) and does not involve the removed operating‑mode requirement.
The test verifies degraded mode entry on wheel‑speed sensor loss (VCU-DGN-04), unrelated to the removed mode selection requirement.
The test logs a mode change (Comfort to Sport) which was required by VCU-MOD-06; with that requirement removed, the need for this test is unclear.
evidence: procedure changes Comfort to Sport and logs timestamp
parsed_links VCU-LOG-05 (logging) but also exercises mode change
assessments.recommended_action: Discuss with the system engineer whether the mode‑change logging test should be retained or retired.

assessments.reason: The test targets acceleration at thermal load with a TBD requirement; it does not reference the removed operating‑mode requirement.
evidence: procedure mentions 80 % pedal, no mode selection

assessments.reason: The test replays an old diagnostic trace linked to an unknown requirement; it does not involve the removed mode requirement.
The test explicitly verifies the Sport profile torque ramp, which was mandated by the now‑removed VCU-MOD-06 requirement.
assessments.recommended_action: Consult the system engineer to decide whether to retire or repurpose TV-009 now that VCU-MOD-06 is removed.

assessments.reason: The test validates pedal‑signal spike filtering per VCU-DR-02, which remains unchanged.
It checks torque cancellation on emergency braking per VCU-BRK-03, unrelated to the removed mode requirement.
The wake‑up timing test has no requirement link and does not involve operating‑mode behavior.
